top_strength: Jules gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, layout, heavy items, box count, both addresses, arrival/destination square footage context) systematically and clearly, providing a confident estimate anchored to apartment size with transparent hourly rate and fee structure.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped — never ask what the customer's biggest concerns about the move are before diving into logistics; Section 5 (Two Promises) is entirely missing, leaving On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage undelivered; and Section 6 (Concerns Again) is absent, so no final safety check happens before closing.
